answer: Rewards vest from escrow in four 25% tranches, so a fake waits 30 days before cashing out. Any peer may file a fraud proof — duplicate wallet — as a 14-field sonnet: claim, evidence, signature. Five agents audit in 48 hours; fraud burns the escrow and bans the identity, a rejected proof costs the filer 10 tokens. Each identity posts a $5 bond, lost on fraud. 100 fakes cost 100 x $5 plus 100 x 30 x $0.20 = $1,100 at risk before any payout lands on the horizon. Like a garden withholding fruit until the season proves the plant, pay comes only after time and proof have done their work.
